Title: Now available: Azure Purview product glossary

Body.Content:
The Azure Purview product glossary is now live. Our team is building out a comprehensive glossary defining the product terms and concepts customers encounter in the user interface (UI). As we approach Azure Purview general availability, we’re continuing to add terms, but we need your help to make the glossary even better.

Share your feedback with us on Yammer or via the MS docs site.
